hero.title: Where Every Neighbour is Family, Every Festival a Memory.
hero.body: For years, our club has stood as the cultural and social heartbeat of Bhuniajibarh. Join us as we celebrate life, heritage, and the joy of standing by one another.

about.title: A home for our community
about.body: Founded with a deep commitment to our village, Chayanika Club is a space where tradition meets youthful energy. We work all year round to organize cultural festivals, promote sports and fitness, and stand beside our people through social welfare initiatives.

about.title: About Us
about.description: Who we are, what we believe and why we gather.
about.storyBody: Established in 1965 in the village of Bhuniajibarh, Ramnagar, Chayanika Club began as a humble initiative by local visionaries and youth to build a common ground for cultural celebration, sports, and mutual support. Over nearly six decades, guided by generation after generation of dedicated members, our club has grown into a cornerstone of community life in Purba Medinipur — keeping our traditions alive and standing united through every season.
about.visionBody: To build a united, self-reliant, and culturally vibrant Bhuniajibarh where every generation finds joy, brotherhood, and the opportunity to grow with dignity.
about.missionBody: Organizing year-round cultural festivals and sports tournaments, encouraging youth in constructive activities, and standing beside our neighbours through health camps, education support, and social welfare.

togetherness.title: Togetherness
togetherness.body: Everyone has a place, whatever their age or background.

culture.title: Culture
culture.body: We celebrate and pass on the traditions we love.

service.title: Service
service.body: We show up for our neighbours and our village.

about.whyBody: In an era of rapid change, Chayanika Club exists to keep the soul of our village connected. We are here to ensure that every festival feels like family, that children and youth find constructive paths through sports, arts, and education, and that no family in our neighbourhood ever has to face difficulties alone.

faq.a1: Anyone who loves Bhuniajibarh, respects our community values, and wants to contribute to cultural, sports, and social welfare activities is warmly welcome to apply, regardless of age or background.
faq.a2: No, membership is completely free. We welcome all community members to participate, volunteer, and be part of our family without any charge.
faq.a3: Our team usually reviews enquiries and contacts you via phone call or WhatsApp within 2 to 3 days.
